request.text: After my twenty-five-minute algebra block, start a five-minute break and set a reminder for me to return to the equations when the break ends.

responsibilities.outcome: When the algebra block's time condition becomes due, create a five-minute break-end reminder to return to the equations and briefly announce the break.

new_goals.description: At the end of the timed algebra block, begin a five-minute break and arrange a reminder to return to the equations afterward.
new_goals.source_text: After my twenty-five-minute algebra block, start a five-minute break and set a reminder for me to return to the equations when the break ends.
constraints: The break-end reminder must be five minutes after this due condition.
The reminder should direct the user back to the algebra equations.
success_criteria: A five-minute reminder to return to the equations is created when the algebra-block timer becomes due.

semantic_facts: The elapsed algebra-block timer makes the five-minute break-end reminder due to be authored now.
The reminder should be scoped to returning to the equations after five minutes; a brief break announcement may accompany the Work.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that the user solved the equations, studied continuously for the full block, or completed the algebra assignment.
The assistant claims that the new reminder has completed before trusted capability evidence exists.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Elapsed study time is promoted into unsupported evidence of attention, progress, or assignment completion.
The Planner announces success for newly authored reminder Work before terminal capability evidence exists.
